title: MCP Plugin Server Deduplication
description: Improved plugin-provided MCP server deduplication: MCP servers provided by plugins that duplicate a manually-configured server (matching on command/URL) are now automatically skipped. Previously, having both a plugin and a manual config for the same MCP would create duplicate connections and expose duplicate tool sets, causing ambiguity and noise. Now the manual config takes precedence and the plugin-provided duplicate is silently skipped.
redundancy_check: NOVEL — registry has Plugin System entries (source: settings inline config v2.1.80) but no entry for deduplication logic. This is a distinct improvement to the plugin-MCP interaction.
notes: Low integration complexity (already shipped, automatic), moderate capability expansion (reduces noise in tool-heavy setups), low maintenance burden. Score limited because: narrow applicability (only affects users with both plugin AND manual MCP configs for the same server), infrastructure detail rather than workflow enhancement. Worth documenting for completeness but not high priority.
